description.zh:
返回值语言，取值：

- zh-CN：中文

- en-US（默认值）：英文
description.en:
The language of the response. Valid values:

*   zh-CN: Chinese
*   en-US (default): English

description.zh: 用户生成的请求token。用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh:
域名实例的启用状态：

- enable：启用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略生效。

- disable：禁用状态，GTM实例智能调度策略不可用。
description.en:
The enabling state of the access domain name. Valid values:

*   enable: The access domain name is enabled and the intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance takes effect.
*   disable: The access domain name is disabled and the intelligent scheduling policy of the GTM instance does not take effect.
The ID of the GTM 3.0 instance.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为**1**，默认为**1**。
description.en: Current page number, starting at **1**, default is **1**.

description.zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数，最大值**100**，默认为**20**。
description.en: The number of rows per page when paginating queries, with a maximum value of **100**, and a default of **20**.

description.zh: GTM接入域名。格式为接入域名主机记录（ScheduleHostname参数值）+主域或子域（ScheduleZoneName参数值）。
description.en: The GTM access domain name. The value of this parameter is composed of the value of ScheduleHostname and the value of ScheduleZoneName.

description.zh: GTM接入域名的主域（example.com）或子域（a.example.com）。一般为GTM实例所在账号下，在云解析DNS控制台权威解析中托管的域名。
description.en: The zone (such as example.com) or subzone (such as a.example.com) of the GTM access domain name. In most cases, the zone or subzone is hosted in Authoritative DNS Resolution of the Alibaba Cloud DNS console within the account to which the GTM instance belongs.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns list-cloud-gtm-instance-configs --accept-language en-US --client-token 1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000 --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --instance-id gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000 --schedule-zone-name example.com --enable-status enable --remark test --schedule-domain-name www.example.com --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alidns ListCloudGtmInstanceConfigs --region cn-hangzhou --ScheduleZoneName 'example.com' --PageSize 20 --PageNumber 1 --InstanceId 'gtm-cn-wwo3a3h0000' --EnableStatus enable --AcceptLanguage 'en-US' --ClientToken '1ae05db4-10e7-11ef-b126-00163e240000' --ScheduleDomainName 'www.example.com' --Remark test
